001-defaults-full.json.note: Every documented default at once, which is what the app writes on first run.

002-display-named-one-char.json.note: A named display whose name is a single character.

003-display-named-128-chars.json.note: A named display whose name is exactly 128 characters, with non-ASCII letters.

004-display-named-spaces.json.note: A named display with spaces and non-ASCII letters in a shorter name.

005-strip-disabled.json.note: The strip turned off, with its other settings kept.

012-sky-clock-only.json.note: The sky shows only the clock.

013-sky-hemisphere-south.json.note: The southern hemisphere for the sky.

015-volume-one-bell-off.json.note: Volume at 1 with the bell turned off.

017-quiet-hours-daytime.json.note: A quiet range inside one day.

018-quiet-hours-cross-midnight.json.note: A quiet range that crosses midnight.

020-idle-minutes-5.json.note: Ambient mode after 5 idle minutes, the minimum.

021-idle-minutes-60.json.note: Ambient mode after 60 idle minutes, the maximum.

022-idle-minutes-off.json.note: Ambient mode off, with idle_minutes null.

024-shortcut-alt-f12.json.note: A two-part accelerator with a function key.

027-species-full-map.json.note: Every tool has a species override.

028-species-value-beaver.json.note: The species beaver is used as an override for claude and gemini.

029-species-value-otter.json.note: The species otter is used as an override for claude and gemini.

030-species-value-frog.json.note: The species frog is used as an override for claude and gemini.

031-species-value-hare.json.note: The species hare is used as an override for claude and gemini.

032-species-value-mole.json.note: The species mole is used as an override for claude and gemini.

033-species-value-heron.json.note: The species heron is used as an override for claude and gemini.

034-species-value-hedgehog.json.note: The species hedgehog is used as an override for claude and gemini.

035-species-key-claude.json.note: A single species override keyed by the tool claude.

036-species-key-codex.json.note: A single species override keyed by the tool codex.

037-species-key-opencode.json.note: A single species override keyed by the tool opencode.

038-species-key-antigravity.json.note: A single species override keyed by the tool antigravity.

039-species-key-gemini.json.note: A single species override keyed by the tool gemini.

040-species-key-cursor.json.note: A single species override keyed by the tool cursor.

041-species-key-aider.json.note: A single species override keyed by the tool aider.

042-species-key-other.json.note: A single species override keyed by the tool other.

045-notifications-long-turn-off.json.note: The long turn notification turned off.

048-privacy-project-names-on.json.note: Project names shown as the last folder segment only.

051-reduced-motion-always.json.note: Reduced motion forced on regardless of the OS setting.

052-updates-check-on.json.note: The direct-download update check turned on.

001-root-array.json.note: The root must be an object, not an array.

002-root-null.json.note: The root must be an object, not null.

003-root-string.json.note: The root must be an object, not a string.

004-missing-schema-version.json.note: The top-level group schema_version is required.

005-missing-strip.json.note: The top-level group strip is required.

006-missing-sky.json.note: The top-level group sky is required.

007-missing-sound.json.note: The top-level group sound is required.

008-missing-notifications.json.note: The top-level group notifications is required.

009-missing-ambient.json.note: The top-level group ambient is required.

010-missing-agents.json.note: The top-level group agents is required.

011-missing-privacy.json.note: The top-level group privacy is required.

012-missing-other.json.note: The top-level group other is required.

013-missing-updates.json.note: The top-level group updates is required.

014-unknown-root-field.json.note: An unknown top-level field is rejected.

015-unknown-strip-field.json.note: An unknown field in strip is rejected.

016-unknown-display-field.json.note: An unknown field in the auto display object is rejected.

017-unknown-sky-field.json.note: An unknown field in sky is rejected.

018-unknown-sound-field.json.note: An unknown field in sound is rejected.

019-unknown-quiet-hours-field.json.note: An unknown field inside a quiet_hours range is rejected.

020-unknown-notifications-field.json.note: An unknown field in notifications is rejected.

021-unknown-ambient-field.json.note: An unknown field in ambient is rejected.

022-unknown-agents-field.json.note: An unknown field in agents is rejected.

023-unknown-privacy-field.json.note: An unknown field in privacy is rejected.

024-unknown-other-field.json.note: An unknown field in other is rejected.

025-unknown-updates-field.json.note: An unknown field in updates is rejected.

026-height-71.json.note: A strip height of 71 is below the minimum of 72.

027-height-161.json.note: A strip height of 161 is above the maximum of 160.

028-height-fractional.json.note: A strip height must be a whole number.

029-height-string.json.note: A strip height must be a number, not a string.

032-quiet-hours-start-24-00.json.note: The hour 24 is not a valid start time.

033-quiet-hours-start-no-leading-zero.js.note: A start time must have two digits for the hour (7:30 is rejected).

034-quiet-hours-end-minute-60.json.note: The minute 60 is not a valid end time.

035-quiet-hours-missing-end.json.note: A quiet range needs both start and end.

036-idle-minutes-4.json.note: Idle minutes of 4 is below the minimum of 5.

037-idle-minutes-61.json.note: Idle minutes of 61 is above the maximum of 60.

038-idle-minutes-zero.json.note: Idle minutes of 0 is not an allowed value (use null for off).

039-idle-minutes-fractional.json.note: Idle minutes must be a whole number.

040-shortcut-with-space.json.note: A shortcut may not contain a space.

041-shortcut-empty-string.json.note: An empty shortcut string is rejected (use null for none).

042-shortcut-trailing-plus.json.note: A shortcut may not end with a plus sign.

043-shortcut-over-64-chars.json.note: A shortcut of 65 characters is over the limit.

044-display-named-without-name.json.note: A named display must carry a name.

045-display-auto-with-name.json.note: An auto display may not carry a name.

046-display-unknown-mode.json.note: The display mode must be auto or named.

047-display-name-empty.json.note: A display name may not be empty.

048-display-name-newline.json.note: A display name may not contain a control character.

049-display-name-129-chars.json.note: A display name over 128 characters is rejected.

050-species-unknown-value.json.note: A species must be one of the seven known species.

051-species-unknown-tool-key.json.note: A species key must be a known tool.

052-species-key-wrong-case.json.note: Tool keys are lowercase, so Claude is rejected.

053-layer-mode-always-on-top.json.note: layer_mode has no always_on_top value; on_top is the name.

054-reduced-motion-never.json.note: reduced_motion allows only follow_os or always.

055-sky-mode-unknown.json.note: The sky mode must be usage_and_clock or clock_only.

056-hemisphere-unknown.json.note: The hemisphere must be north or south.

057-schema-version-2.json.note: schema_version must be 1 for this contract.

058-strip-enabled-string.json.note: The enabled flag must be a boolean.

059-bell-null.json.note: The bell flag may not be null.

060-project-names-number.json.note: The project_names flag must be a boolean, not 0 or 1.

061-updates-check-string.json.note: The update check flag must be a boolean.

066-ambient-missing-shortcut.json.note: shortcut is required in ambient (null when none).
